name: SRTM 30m (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission)
crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS84 geographic), heights referenced to EGM96
labels: Surface elevation (DSM). Radar-derived; includes vegetation and buildings.
license: Public domain (US government work). Freely downloadable.
provenance: NASA EarthExplorer or USGS Earth Resources Observation and Science (EROS) Center. No registration required for download.
limitations: HISTORICAL METADATA ONLY — NOT USED FOR TRAINING/VALIDATION/PRODUCTION INFERENCE. 2000 vintage — does not reflect modern construction. 30m resolution insufficient for building-level analysis. Prohibited from production under data.gov.in rule.
intended_use: HISTORICAL METADATA ONLY — NOT USED FOR TRAINING/VALIDATION/PRODUCTION INFERENCE. Production datasets must come from data.gov.in or official state/UT portals.
